zh: 与 TLS 1.2 对齐：以增量方式改写 TLS 1.2。
没有 DTLS 1.1：版本号跳过以与 TLS 同步。
AEAD 套件复用：与 TLS 1.2 完全一致地使用。
静默丢弃：无效记录的默认处置。
致命告警：一旦选择告警就必须 fatal。
epoch 复用限制：两倍 TCP MSL 内不得复用。
en: Aligned with TLS 1.2: presented as deltas on TLS 1.2.
No DTLS 1.1: the number was skipped to stay in step with TLS.
AEAD suites reused: usable exactly as in TLS 1.2.
Silent discard: the default handling of invalid records.
Fatal alerts only: if alerting, it must be fatal.
Epoch reuse limit: no reuse within twice the TCP maximum segment lifetime.
